faq.a: Oumar is associated with the Arabic form عُمَر, whose core sense is oumar; umar (west african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Oumar?
faq.a: Oumar is associated with Arabic. Oumar is the West African form of Arabic عُمَر (ʿUmar), associated with the sense 'flourishing, populated'. It was borne by the second caliph.
Yes — the underlying form عُمَر is Arabic.
Oumar can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Oumar should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUmar is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Oumar mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Oumar is rendered عمر and carries the sense عمر، آباد کرنے والا.

faq.q: What does Oumar mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Oumar is rendered عمر and carries the sense عمر، آبادکننده.
A romanized syllable approximation is ou-mar. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Oumar?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Oumar, oumar. Script forms are عمر, عُمَر, उमर.

faq.q: Is Oumar a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
